name: Lyndsey Craine
bio: Lyndsey Craine graduated from York St. John University with a degree in Film and Television Production. Lyndsey's feature film roles have gravitated towards the horror genre including most recently parts in Eating Miss Campbell (Refuse Films) and Book of Monsters (Dark Rift Horror) which both premiered at London's Frightfest in Leicester Square. Book of Monsters was Lyndsey's first leading role in a feature film and her performance earned her multiple nominations for Best Actress at genre festivals around the world during the film's festival run.
